title: Hexagon Sorting game with just 6.25$ token cost
author: shottycoin
selftext:
One of the users of Pixelfork created this Hexagon Sorting game for Android and iOS. ngl this was surprised me how he nailed almost all prompts and generated this game with least amount of prompts.

Game generation is not about expecting everything in one shot. It requires some prompting skills. You need to know correct workflow. This is why I'm planning to share series of tutorials about how you can get more done with less prompts. Will post here. 

Would love to hear your feedbacks too for this game.

Playable link: [https://www.pixelfork.ai/publish/41fa758a-0f6d-4f66-9bb0-e92e79e6b488N](https://www.pixelfork.ai/publish/41fa758a-0f6d-4f66-9bb0-e92e79e6b488N)

**Note: For the best experience use mobile device to play.**
